t: Forge Steel spring action centre punch designed to create precise indentations in various materials. The robust marking tool is ideal for trade professionals, and features a 4mm tip diameter and spring-action mechanism, to provide an accurate starting point for drilling holes; the punch significantly reduces drill bit wandering and ensures cleaner, more precise results. The heat-treated chrome vanadium steel shaft offers enhanced durability and strength for consistent performance, whilst the 130mm length and knurled brass body provide a comfortable and secure grip. Suitable for marking tiles, breeze blocks, granite, plaster and cement, the centre punch is a versatile addition to professional toolkits.
